description: This bar chart illustrates the popularity scores across three categories—Movies, Songs, and Basketball—for five distinct groups of data, differentiated by color and pattern: Llama3 (solid blue), Qwen2 (solid red), ChatGPT (solid yellow), Acc=0 & GT Ans (hatched blue), and Acc=0 & Gene Ans (hatched red), with Acc=1 & GT Ans (hatched yellow) also represented. The vertical axis, labeled “Popularity,” is scaled linearly from 20 to 220 in increments of 20, with tick marks at every 20-unit interval. The horizontal axis presents the three categories—Movies, Songs, and Basketball—in left-to-right order. Within each category, there are five bars corresponding to the five groups, arranged side-by-side without grouping or stacking. The bars are sorted in descending order of height within each category. In the “Movies” category, the tallest bar is Llama3 (~40), followed by Qwen2 (~30), ChatGPT (~25), Acc=0 & GT Ans (~20), and Acc=1 & GT Ans (~20). In the “Songs” category, the tallest bar is Llama3 (~70), followed by Qwen2 (~60), ChatGPT (~50), Acc=0 & GT Ans (~40), and Acc=1 & GT Ans (~40). In the “Basketball” category, the tallest bar is Qwen2 (~200), followed by Llama3 (~180), ChatGPT (~170), Acc=0 & GT Ans (~100), and Acc=1 & GT Ans (~140). No bars are visually emphasized beyond their height and color/pattern differentiation.
